original_ai_output.title_zh: 联邦首都区流离失所妇女呼吁改善医疗、教育与赋权
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿布贾Wassa流离失所者营地的妇女在Civitas Auxilium Foundation成立五周年暨Project RISE启动仪式上，呼吁改善医疗、经济赋权和教育。她们表示高昂的医疗费用导致可预防的并发症和死亡，近期有三名妇女死于分娩并发症，营地还出现儿童因水源性疾病死亡的情况。她们还呼吁政府建立身份识别卡制度，以便流离失所者低价或免费在公立医院就医，并希望开设中学以减少儿童辍学。

location.raw_text: Wassa Internally Displaced Persons (IDP) camp, Abuja

key_facts.fact: Wassa流离失所者营地的妇女呼吁改善医疗、经济赋权和教育
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Women at the Wassa Internally Displaced Persons (IDP) camp have appealed for improved healthcare, economic empowerment and education

key_facts.fact: 营地代表称近期有三名妇女死于分娩并发症，其中一人与双胞胎婴儿一同死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Recently, we lost three women from complications during childbirth, and one of them died alongside her twin babies.

key_facts.fact: 营地近期还出现儿童因水源性疾病死亡的情况
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: She added that the camp had also recently recorded the deaths of children from waterborne diseases.

key_facts.fact: 妇女呼吁政府建立身份识别卡制度，使流离失所者能低价或免费在公立医院就医
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: She urged the government and partners to introduce an identification card system to enable IDPs to access treatment at public hospitals at little or no cost.

key_facts.fact: Project RISE计划在贝努埃州和联邦首都区为至少100名妇女提供职业培训
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: We aim to build practical skills of at least 100 women in catering, baking, bag making and other vocational trades

uncertainties: 死亡人数与原因系营地妇女单方面陈述，尚未获得独立核实
事件为单一来源报道（尼日利亚通讯社）
